scope: Audit and triage of the 15-pillar x 10-criterion governance coverage matrix; no publication or benchmark mutation.

method.current_matrix_status: All 150 cells were UNASSESSED at input.
method.reviewed_evidence_rule: Only REVIEWED bindings attached to candidate notes/questions count as reviewed evidence; source counts and candidate overlap alone do not.
method.criterion_relevance_rule: Lexical/heading signals and existing index edges are triage signals only; they do not establish coverage completion.
method.completion_rule: A cell can be advanced only through a reviewed domain release with criterion-specific evidence, provenance, questions and navigation checks.
